source_caption_text:
Future slid way too effortlessly on this 😤🔥

Future really slid on EST Gee’s “Sh**t It Myself,” matching the dark production with that cold, laid-back delivery he’s known for. He doesn’t try to overdo anything either, letting every line land with that effortless confidence.

His verse moves between where he came from and where he is now, touching on Zone 6, money, luxury and everything that came with his rise. The way he casually runs through those details makes the verse feel even harder.

It’s the delivery that really makes Future’s part stand out. He sounds completely unfazed throughout the whole verse, riding the beat like he was made for it. Future and EST Gee were a perfect match on this one.

#future #estgee #hiphop
